readout_other: sensory antidromic nerve conduction velocity (sNCV) and sensory nerve action potential (sNAP) of the radial nerve; supramaximal stimulation intensity (SSI); pressure pain threshold (PPT) by dolorimeter; skin temperature by infrared thermography
direction_notes: Pulsed ultrasound significantly increased the supramaximal stimulation intensity (SSI) needed versus placebo, but sensory nerve conduction velocity, sensory nerve action potential amplitude and pressure pain threshold did not differ from placebo.

exposures.label: Pulsed ultrasound to the superficial branch of the radial nerve

target.label: superficial branch of the radial nerve of the nondominant arm

timing.protocol_description: Therapeutic ultrasound was applied with an intensity of 1 W/cm2, pulsed 1:5, frequency 3 MHz, via a transducer with a surface area of 2.5 cm2, at the radial side of the forearm from 5 to 15 cm proximal to the metacarpophalangeal joint of the thumb, over the course of the superficial branch of the radial nerve, for 5 minutes, with the transducer moved dynamically over the treatment area. Placebo used the same device, area and duration with intensity set to zero.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Twelve healthy volunteers (8 male, 4 female, aged 22-38 years) were examined. The study participants were students and their acquaintances. They were recruited by oral announcement at the university department. Each subject was informed verbally and in writing about the benefits and the risks of this study before the examination. Written informed consent was obtained before study initiation from all participants. The study was approved by the Ethics Committee of the Medical University of Vienna (EK Nr. 487/2007).

flags.reason: Paper states the pulse ratio as 'pulsed 1:5' without defining whether this is on:off or on:total; left duty_cycle_pct not_reported rather than assume a convention.
Paper reports only 'intensity 1 W/cm2' without specifying ISATA/ISPTA/domain; placed in unspecified_domain.
Crossover design gave each subject one real-ultrasound session and one placebo session on separate days; n_sessions_per_subject counts only the real-ultrasound session.
